name: Amdocs
description: Amdocs offers a comprehensive BSS/OSS suite with CPQ capabilities, competing directly with Skyvera's Salesforce-native CloudSense platform for telecom operators.
strengths: Deeply integrated OSS/BSS ecosystem with decades of telecom industry experience
Strong global presence with established relationships among major carriers
Advanced billing and revenue management capabilities beyond CPQ
weaknesses: Heavy on-premise deployment model with slower cloud migration compared to Skyvera's Salesforce-native architecture
Complex implementation requiring extensive customization versus Skyvera's rapid deployment
Higher total cost of ownership and licensing fees for mid-market telecom operators

name: Oracle Communications
description: Oracle Communications delivers a unified CPQ and billing platform targeting telecom service providers, directly competing with Skyvera's CloudSense solution.
strengths: Enterprise-grade infrastructure with robust database and analytics capabilities
Bundled solutions with Oracle's broader cloud ecosystem reducing integration complexity
Extensive compliance certifications for regulated telecom markets
weaknesses: Requires Oracle Cloud infrastructure rather than operating natively on Salesforce
Steeper learning curve and longer implementation timeline versus Skyvera's user-friendly design
Less agile for rapid service bundle creation, limiting time-to-market for new telecom offerings
